defects_found_in_the_producer.summary: The first module-provenance loop rebuilt its request table per module and compared record objects by identity, so every lookup returned undefined and zero modules were compared while the check still printed a pass.
defects_found_in_the_producer.resolution: The table is built once, and the check asserts comparedModules === moduleEntries.length so an uncompared module fails the run.

defects_found_in_the_producer.summary: The first canonical run reported a console error count without naming the errors.
defects_found_in_the_producer.resolution: The producer now reports the verbatim texts and binds the console error count to the observed failed-request count, with every failed request required to be the expected /favicon.ico 404. A page-originated console error without a matching failed request fails the run.

gaps.name: event-driven DOM markers
gaps.reason: data-team-cancel and data-permission-option are only emitted for a rendered Session. This control daemon binds no Session owner, so no Session exists to cancel and no permission is pending. Their absence is the same gap D06/D08 already records and is not treated as evidence here.

gaps.name: history rows through the installed entry
gaps.reason: The history view renders data-history-count=0 with 0 rows in this configuration. The marker render is proven; a non-empty history row is not.

blocking_findings: B1: this file recorded tarball_bytes=1536594 while the receipt and the log record 1536584.

B2: the installed-artifact correction was incomplete; the D08 acceptance records, the D08 gate note, the D08 governance row, the serve-entry function note and the console-host module note still asserted that installed-artifact browser evidence does not exist.
B3: the provenance check claimed that no process command line references the source tree while only the control and agent command lines were examined; the registry daemon was never inspected.
advisories: A1: requestIdByUrl was built and never used.
A2: gap() was never called, so the driver gaps array was always empty and "0 gaps" carried no information.
A3: the console-error binding passed whenever one favicon 404 existed, which is weaker than the notes claimed.
A4: the stray-process counts were recorded but never asserted.
A5: the D07 gate command does not run this producer, so the closed item rests on referenced evidence rather than on the gate command (the same convention the D08-browser producer uses).
round_1.resolution: B1: this file is now generated from receipt.json and the committed PNG by regenerate-verification.mjs instead of being retyped. B2: eleven sites now carry a dated 2026-10-14 correction. B3: the producer inspects all three Teams daemon command lines and states exactly which ones it examined. A1-A4: the dead code is removed, the receipt declares no gap of its own, the console-error count is bound to the observed failed-request count, and a stray process fails the run. A5 is recorded in the D07 gate note.

scope_note: This artifact proves the installed package serves the frozen D07 console to a real browser whose page fetches, subscribes and renders from that origin, and that the bytes the browser received are the installed package files. It does not prove restart, a deployed-entrypoint replay, cross-device behaviour, mobile layout, or any control-daemon Session/permission write. The D07 gate therefore stays partial, and the D07 gate command does not run this producer: the closed item rests on this referenced evidence, which is the same convention the D08-browser producer uses.
